description: This file defines the GrainPropertiesResolver class responsible for resolving GrainProperties associated with GrainType in the Orleans framework. It includes methods to retrieve grain properties, handling cluster manifest data, and parsing generic grain types.

classes.name: GrainPropertiesResolver
classes.description: Responsible for resolving GrainProperties for given GrainType values using information from the cluster manifest provider.

methods.name: GrainPropertiesResolver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resolver with a cluster manifest provider.

methods.name: GetGrainProperties
methods.description: Retrieves GrainProperties for a specified GrainType, returning default properties if not found.

methods.name: TryGetGrainProperties
methods.description: Attempts to find and output GrainProperties for a given GrainType, returning true if successful.
